`internal/cmd/review.go` decides, `internal/cli/reviews.go` renders:

- `lode review add <task-id> [--base-ref <sha>] [--reason "…"]`: default sha
  from `gitexec` `rev-parse HEAD` in the current worktree; refused outside
  a worktree without `--base-ref`; `--reason` required for the lease holder
  (Decisions); prints the defaulted roster when it defaulted one.
- `lode review comment <id> --anchor <repo>:<path>:<additions|deletions>:<line>`
  reads `anchor_text` from the working tree at that line (or from
  `git show <base_ref>:<path>` when not in the tree) and `blob_sha` from
  `git rev-parse <base_ref>:<path>`; `--anchor-text` overrides for a
  reviewer with no checkout. `--quote` stays the document form.
- `lode review submit <id>`: change arm: HEAD sha, then for every open
  change thread: old file `git show <blob_sha>`, new file from HEAD,
  `review.ReanchorLine`, build `Reanchors`; print one line per thread with
  its `stage` and `obsolete` ones flagged.
- `lode review show <id>`: for a change review in its worktree, print the
  raw `git diff <merge-base>..<base_ref>` after the threads (WL-REQ-1326);
  outside, print where the diff is. `cmd.reviewDiff(review)` is the helper
  part 4's desk reuses.
- `lode task show` prints the `review <id> <state>, opened by <actor>:
  <reason>` line from `model.TaskDetail.Review` (`cli.TaskDetailRender`).

First cmd test: with a git fixture built the way `internal/cmd/gate_test.go`
builds one through `gitexec` (there is no shared worktree fixture; lift the
helper if a second test needs it), open a change review, comment on a line,
rewrite the file above it, `submit`, and assert `show --json` has the thread
at the new line with `stage` reported on stdout.

- [ ] `go test -trimpath ./internal/cmd -run 'ReviewChange|ReviewSubmit' -count=1` against Postgres — `ok`.
- [ ] Manual: in a real worktree, open, comment, edit, submit; paste the stage lines into the PR.
- [ ] Commit: `lode review: change reviews from the worktree; add, comment, submit re-anchors, show prints the diff (WL-REQ-1775, WL-REQ-1326)`.
